fact: URSB's centralised digital Non-Individual Register, issuing each entity a unique Entity Registration Number, is in its final stages of testing with full rollout expected by June 2026, URSB officials say.
URSB unveiled its e-Registry, an online platform replacing the Online Business Registration System and giving access to business registration services through a single portal.

The Auditor General's report for the year ended 2025 describes URSB's Online Business Registration System, launched in December 2022, as a digital business registration platform that remains slow, with frequent outages.

The Ministry of ICT says the Online Business Registration System of the Uganda Registration Services Bureau is live, having registered 36,885 businesses and 83,966 companies in under a year since go-live.

URSB's ICT commissioner Arthur Kwesiga said all URSB services are online 24/7 after paper records were digitised, and the Online Business Registration System lets clients search company status, track applications and access accounts remotely.

The Uganda Registration Services Bureau says its eRegistry online platform, which replaced the Online Business Registration System, is running, and its new URSB Connect app adds company and business-name registration as an extra channel.

URA says that, under section 4 of the Tax Procedures Code Act, the Entity or Business Registration Number issued by URSB will serve as the tax identifier for non-individuals, and that the move from the TIN has begun; TINs stop being recognised at full rollout.

URSB told Parliament's COSASE committee on 10 November 2026 that its Online Business Registration System (OBRS), which the Auditor General found down for long periods between August 2023 and September 2025, now has 99% availability and processes services such as certification instantly.
